title: The Last Supper, Betrayal, and Arrest

questions.question: Now the Feast of Unleavened Bread drew near, which is called the Passover. Why were the chief priests and scribes seeking how to put Jesus to death secretly?
options: For they feared the people
Because Pilate ordered it so
They lacked authority from Rome entirely
Because Jesus rarely left his house openly
questions.explanation: Luke 22:2 (ESV): "And the chief priests and the scribes were seeking how to put him to death, for they feared the people."

questions.question: Who entered into Judas called Iscariot, who was of the number of the twelve, leading him to conspire to betray Jesus?
options: Satan
A demon of greed entirely
Beelzebul personally
Legion
questions.explanation: Luke 22:3 (ESV): "Then Satan entered into Judas called Iscariot, who was of the number of the twelve."

questions.question: When the day of Unleavened Bread came on which the Passover lamb had to be sacrificed, whom did Jesus send to prepare the Passover?
options: Peter and John
James and Andrew
Philip and Bartholomew
Thomas and Matthew
questions.explanation: Luke 22:8 (ESV): "So Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, 'Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat it.'"

questions.question: Jesus told Peter and John that when they enter the city, a man will meet them carrying what?
options: A jar of water
A slaughtered lamb precisely
A sack of fine flour entirely
A golden goblet
questions.explanation: Luke 22:10 (ESV): "He said to them, 'Behold, when you have entered the city, a man carrying a jar of water will meet you. Follow him into the house that he enters...'"

questions.question: When the hour came, they reclined at table. Jesus broke bread, gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, "This is my body, which is given for you. Do this..."?
options: "...in remembrance of me."
"...to ensure your salvation entirely."
"...until the angels sing in heaven."
"...as often as you feast together on the Sabbath."
questions.explanation: Luke 22:19 (ESV): "And he took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke it and gave it to them, saying, 'This is my body, which is given for you. Do this in remembrance of me.'"

questions.question: Likewise with the cup after they had eaten, saying, "This cup that is poured out for you is..."?
options: "...the new covenant in my blood."
"...the wrath of God falling heavily upon the unrighteous."
"...the final drink before I suffer entirely."
"...a symbol of my tears wept for Jerusalem."
questions.explanation: Luke 22:20 (ESV): "And likewise the cup after they had eaten, saying, 'This cup that is poured out for you is the new covenant in my blood.'"

questions.question: A dispute also arose among the disciples as to which of them was to be regarded as the greatest. How did Jesus redefine greatness for them?
options: "Rather, let the greatest among you become as the youngest, and the leader as one who serves."
"The greatest is he who fasts longest and prays the loudest."
"He who carries my cross will be the greatest completely."
"The one who brings the most converts into the kingdom."
questions.correctAnswer: "Rather, let the greatest among you become as the youngest, and the leader as one who serves."
questions.explanation: Luke 22:26 (ESV): "But not so with you. Rather, let the greatest among you become as the youngest, and the leader as one who serves."

questions.question: Jesus told Simon Peter that Satan had demanded to have him, that he might sift him like what?
options: "sift you like wheat"
"crush you like a moth entirely"
"break you like a potter's vessel"
"scatter you like the wind sweeps the chaff"
questions.explanation: Luke 22:31 (ESV): "Simon, Simon, behold, Satan demanded to have you, that he might sift you like wheat,"

questions.question: What did Jesus prophesy about Peter's upcoming denial?
options: "I tell you, Peter, the rooster will not crow this day, until you deny three times that you know me."
"The sun will not rise before you betray me entirely with a kiss."
"Before the third hour passes, you will strike a soldier and flee."
"You will run safely home before the garden gate swings shut."
questions.correctAnswer: "I tell you, Peter, the rooster will not crow this day, until you deny three times that you know me."
questions.explanation: Luke 22:34 (ESV): "Jesus said, 'I tell you, Peter, the rooster will not crow this day, until you deny three times that you know me.'"

questions.question: Jesus told them to sell their cloaks and buy a sword if they didn't have one, in order to fulfill the Scripture: "And he was numbered with the transgressors." How many swords did the disciples say they had?
options: Two swords
Twelve swords
None entirely
Five swords
questions.explanation: Luke 22:38 (ESV): "And they said, 'Look, Lord, here are two swords.' And he said to them, 'It is enough.'"

questions.question: When Jesus arrived at the Mount of Olives and withdrew from them about a stone's throw to pray, what was His prayer?
options: "Father, if you are willing, remove this cup from me. Nevertheless, not my will, but yours, be done."
"Father, send your legions of angels to scatter these men entirely."
"Father, curse the Romans and establish the throne of David now."
"Father, strike the high priest blind so I may escape safely."
questions.correctAnswer: "Father, if you are willing, remove this cup from me. Nevertheless, not my will, but yours, be done."
questions.explanation: Luke 22:42 (ESV): "saying, 'Father, if you are willing, remove this cup from me. Nevertheless, not my will, but yours, be done.'"

questions.question: While Jesus was in agony and prayed more earnestly on the Mount of Olives, what physical manifestation occurred?
options: His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down to the ground
His face shone like the sun once again entirely
He wept until his eyes bled completely
The earth trembled violently beneath his knees
questions.correctAnswer: His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down to the ground
questions.explanation: Luke 22:44 (ESV): "And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly; and his sweat became like great drops of blood falling down to the ground."

questions.question: When the crowd led by Judas arrived to arrest Jesus, what did Judas do to identify Jesus?
options: He drew near to Jesus to kiss him
He pointed his staff firmly at him
He laid his hands upon Jesus' shoulders violently
He shouted "This is the king of the Jews!"
questions.correctAnswer: He drew near to Jesus to kiss him
questions.explanation: Luke 22:47 (ESV): "While he was still speaking, there came a crowd, and the man called Judas... drew near to Jesus to kiss him,"

questions.question: When those who were around Jesus saw what would follow, they asked if they should strike with the sword. One of them struck the servant of the high priest and cut off what?
options: His right ear
His left hand completely
His armor's leather strap heavily
His throat severely
questions.explanation: Luke 22:50 (ESV): "And one of them struck the servant of the high priest and cut off his right ear."

questions.question: Peter followed at a distance and sat by the fire in the courtyard. When a servant girl closely observed him by the firelight, what did she say?
options: "This man also was with him."
"He clearly is a Galilean by his speech!"
"He carries a bloody sword beneath his cloak!"
"I saw him slice the ear of the servant wildly!"
questions.explanation: Luke 22:56 (ESV): "Then a servant girl, seeing him as he sat in the light and looking closely at him, said, 'This man also was with him.'"

key_verse_text: "Father, if you are willing, remove this cup from me. Nevertheless, not my will, but yours, be done."
